sourceInformation.genre: Survival horror, exploration adventure, cooperative puzzle adventure
sourceInformation.perspective: Third-person isometric cutaway with a fixed camera angle; full-floor desktop view and portrait camera follow
sourceInformation.tech: Three.js 0.180.0 (r180), WebGPURenderer with TSL cel materials; Rapier 0.19.3; Web Audio; Gamepad API; WebRTC; BroadcastChannel; AI Hub session client 1.4.0. Single HTML with pinned CDN libraries.
sourceInformation.artDirection: Procedural low-poly mansion diorama, cel-shaded teal and plum surfaces, ink outlines, parchment and amber matchlight
sourceInformation.animation: Three.js AnimationMixer and authored AnimationClip / NumberKeyframeTrack animations for explorers, ghosts, bats, spiders and clocks; procedural particles and camera drift
sourceInformation.audio: Original code-synthesized chamber-style music (10% default), synthesized sound effects and Animalese-style gibberish voices; no audio files
sourceInformation.online: 1–4 player shared-world co-op through AI Hub; standalone same-browser rooms using BroadcastChannel and cross-device WebRTC invitation/reply codes
sourceInformation.testing: Headless tests allowed: scripted full physical playthrough, mechanics assertions, browser state, virtual standard gamepad, real emulated touch events, Web Audio analyser, file deployment, two-page co-op and official AI Hub harness; screenshots for visual composition. Chromium WebGPU is used for solo/input/file checks, Chromium WebGL2 for direct WebRTC, and WebKit WebGL2 for same-browser rooms and Hub checks. Physical controller, real mobile hardware and cross-network NAT compatibility: unknown.
sourceInformation.research: none; native model knowledge only. Supplied AI Hub integration files read and pinned dependencies downloaded.

testingFeedback: 9 game issues found and corrected: two timing/interaction faults, two packaging faults, three visual proportion/framing faults, a Hub startup-order fault and an attract-state leak into cooperative starts. Test-script mistakes and browser/environment restrictions were tracked separately. Final validation: 110/110 checks passed, including all four AI Hub conformance scenarios.

4 blockers: a duplicate bundled identifier, the wrong Rapier CDN module filename, graphics initialization delaying the Hub welcome handshake, and stale attract replay state consuming cooperative input.
The official AI Hub conformance harness: it caught the startup ordering bug and checks time-up, departures, simulated network loss and server-only hosts.
Headless WebGPU screenshots were least useful because capture was corrupted on this machine. I used state checks and the WebGL2 backend for visual inspection.
engineFeedback: Three.js TSL gave all procedural objects a consistent cel palette, and AnimationMixer made reusable creature clips straightforward.

Yes. I initially used an obsolete Rapier module filename and let graphics startup delay the Hub handshake. Headless WebGPU contexts required isolated browser runs; direct WebRTC was verified in Chromium after WebKit did not connect.
The authoritative room, inventory, enemy, light and cooperative simulation, plus input-aware menus, procedural models and synthesized audio.
Coordinating asynchronous startup, fixed-step Rapier movement, native animation and replicated state in one HTML deliverable.
Add a first-party controller focus and navigation layer, including scrollable overlays.
promptFeedback: The source, controller-first direction and complete-demo requirements gave the game a clear identity.
The request to avoid internet research also supplies an online integration contract; I treated reading that contract and downloading libraries as implementation, with no source research.
Making one polished experience cover solo play, cooperative networking, controller, mouse, touch, kiosk replay and a single-file package.
Specify whether standalone multiplayer should require cross-device discovery or allow manual WebRTC invitation codes.

aiHub.name: The House of Creaks
aiHub.tagline: A small flame. A very bad address.
aiHub.description: Explore a matchlit, four-floor mansion, recover a shattered urn, and escape its uninvited guests. Carry one object at a time and brave the dark alone or with up to three friends.
aiHub.controls: WASD / left stick move; Space / R2 match; E / Cross interact; Q / Circle drop; Shift / L1 hush; F / Square ward; Tab / Triangle map; Esc / Options pause; mouse aim and use; touch drag and tap.
